findings.reason: Cooked food in bowls and cut produce such as cabbage are left uncovered inside the refrigerator.
The sink basin contains dirty dishes and cookware, and no dedicated clean handwashing basin is available.
Waste is kept in an open black plastic bag directly on the floor without a rigid lidded dustbin.
The cooktop surface has noticeable food spills and residue, and the wooden chopping board exhibits deep staining and wear.
The Patanjali Cow's Ghee carton displays an expiry date in July (JUL 26 or earlier), which has lapsed compared to today's date of 2026-10-18.

liveness.observed: Hand rested on the edge of the stovetop with 5 fingers touching the counter surface rather than held upright in front of the stove.

continuousTake.detail: The video is recorded in a single continuous take without cuts, edits, or frame freezing.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: This is the first verified audit, so no previous reference exists.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: The kitchen shows recent activity consistent with 6 orders in the past hour, including dirty dishes in the sink, used pans on the stove, and a filled trash bag.

propsSuspected.detail: Ingredients, condiments, and cookware appear genuinely stored and in everyday use without artificial staging.

integrity.kitchenSummary: A compact home/cloud kitchen featuring a stocked refrigerator with fresh vegetables and condiments, a single-basin sink with running water and soiled dishes, a two-burner gas cooktop with pots, spice racks, and ingredient packaging inspections.

en: Cover all cooked food bowls and cut vegetables with lids or wrap, and ensure raw food is kept below ready-to-eat items.
Clear dishes out of the handwash sink so staff always have a dedicated, clean spot with soap and water to wash hands.
Safely discard the expired cow's ghee carton and take a quick moment to review dates on other packaged staples.
Place garbage inside a rigid bin with a tightly closed lid instead of leaving open bags directly on the floor.
Wipe food spills off the cooktop after cooking, and thoroughly scrub or replace heavily stained wooden chopping boards.
hi: फ्रिज में पके हुए खाने और कटी सब्जियों को ढक्कन या पन्नी से ढककर रखें, और कच्चे सामान को तैयार भोजन के नीचे रखें।
हाथ धोने के सिंक से जूठे बर्तन हटाएं ताकि कर्मचारियों के लिए साबुन और पानी से हाथ धोने की अलग साफ जगह बनी रहे।
तारीख निकल चुके घी के डिब्बे को हटा दें और स्टोर में रखे बाकी सामान की एक्सपायरी डेट भी एक बार देख लें।
कचरे को सीधे फर्श पर खुली थैली में रखने के बजाय ढक्कन वाले मजबूत डस्टबिन में रखें।
कुकिंग के बाद चूल्हे की सतह को पोंछकर साफ करें, और ज्यादा पुराने या दागदार लकड़ी के कटिंग बोर्ड को बदलें या अच्छी तरह साफ करें।
or: ଫ୍ରିଜ୍‌ରେ ଥିବା ରନ୍ଧା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଏବଂ କଟା ପନିପରିବାକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ କଞ୍ଚା ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ରନ୍ଧା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ତଳେ ସାଇତି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ସିଙ୍କ୍‌ରୁ ବାସନକୁସନ ହଟାଇ ସେଥିରେ ସାବୁନ ଓ ପାଣି ସହ ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ସଫା ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ମିଆଦ ସରିଯାଇଥିବା ଘିଅ ପ୍ୟାକେଟ୍ ହଟାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ରୋଷେଇ ଘରେ ଥିବା ଅନ୍ୟ ସାମଗ୍ରୀର ଏକ୍ସପାଏରୀ ତାରିଖ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ଅଳିଆକୁ ଚଟାଣ ଉପରେ ଖୋଲା ପଲିଥିନ୍‌ରେ ନରଖି ଢାଙ୍କୁଣୀ ଥିବା ଡଷ୍ଟବିନ୍ ଭିତରେ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ଚୁଲା ଉପରେ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଦାଗକୁ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପୁରୁଣା ଦାଗ ଲାଗିଥିବା କାଠ କଟିଂ ବୋର୍ଡକୁ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଦଳାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
